I will keep this maize plot the simple way I know because cash is never enough, and this plot is small. I own the land, so I will put manure if I can carry enough from home, but I will not spend on chemical fertilizer or sprays this season. I will plant the seed I know, use family hands for weeding and planting, and I will not hire unless things become very bad, which I do not expect on this small piece.
